title: Pure Scareclaw
summary: Scareclaw cards plus Visas Starfrost, with generic Links and staples. Level 3 Scareclaw monsters Special Summon themselves into zones adjacent to or in the same column as another Scareclaw, then Link Summon Scareclaw Tri-Heart to force the entire field into Defense Position.

summary.title: Starters
points: Any Level 3 Scareclaw (Acro, Astra, or Belone) Normal Summons to Link Summon Link-1 Scareclaw Light-Heart, which searches the Field Spell Primitive Planet Reichphobia.

Primitive Planet Reichphobia adds any Scareclaw monster or Visas Starfrost from the Deck to the hand on activation, and destroys a card on the field while 3 or more Defense Position monsters are on the field.

Scareclaw Reichheart Special Summons itself into a zone adjacent to or in the same column as a Scareclaw monster and searches a Scareclaw Spell/Trap (plus draws 1 card if 3+ Defense Position monsters are on the field).

summary.title: Opening: Any Level 3 Scareclaw
steps: Normal Summon a Level 3 Scareclaw and Link Summon Scareclaw Light-Heart to search Primitive Planet Reichphobia.

Activate Primitive Planet Reichphobia to search Scareclaw Reichheart, Special Summon Reichheart below Light-Heart, and search Scareclaw Arrival (plus draw 1 card if 3 Defense Position monsters are on the field).

Activate Scareclaw Arrival to revive the Level 3 Scareclaw in Defense Position, Link Summon Scareclaw Tri-Heart, and use Tri-Heart to revive a Level 3 Scareclaw in Defense Position and search another Scareclaw (such as Scareclaw Kashtira) or set Scareclaw Defanging / Twinsaw.

summary.title: Defense Position Buffs for Scareclaw Tri-Heart
summary.text: While Scareclaw Acro, Scareclaw Astra, and Scareclaw Belone are in Defense Position in your Main Monster Zone, they grant continuous combat buffs to the Scareclaw monster in your Extra Monster Zone (Scareclaw Tri-Heart): Acro grants +300 ATK per Defense Position monster you control, Astra grants an extra attack for each Defense Position Scareclaw with a different name, and Belone grants piercing battle damage.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Scareclaw Tri-Heart changes all face-up monsters on the field to Defense Position, is unaffected by the activated effects of Defense Position monsters, and revives a Level 3 Scareclaw every turn while searching another Scareclaw from the Deck.

Scareclaw Kashtira Special Summons itself as a Quick Effect during either Main Phase, attacks while in Defense Position with 2600 DEF, and negates the effects of any monster your Scareclaw or Kashtira battles.
Visas Starfrost destroys a monster you control to Special Summon itself as a Level 6 Tuner, which triggers Scareclaw Light-Heart to revive itself from the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Scareclaw Defanging prevents your Scareclaw Link Monsters and Visas Starfrost from being targeted or destroyed by opponent's card effects and banishes any monster they destroy by battle.

Scareclaw Twinsaw Tributes a Scareclaw to destroy two cards the opponent controls—and if you control Visas Starfrost, those cards are banished instead; from the GY, it stops Link Monsters from activating effects.
Scareclaw Sclash lets a Scareclaw or Visas attack from Defense Position and sends itself to the GY to negate a card or effect, while Scareclaw Straddle boosts ATK or negates targeting.
